notes.title: Up Close and Personal!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We are still on a bit of a high after finally launching EvilVEvil this last week! Some of you have been asking what “Season 01” is all about, so we wanted to share some more information about our plans for the forthcoming Season 02 of EvilVEvil. We are calling it, “Up Close and Personal.” 

For Season 02, our focus was to add more variety, more replayability, and new ways to experience the game overall. Our current plans include… 

[list]
[*] Launching on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X | S 
[*] An all-new game mode called, called “Arena Mode”
[*] 3 new characters, each with their own abilities and unique skins
[*] 5 new weapons as part of paid DLC packs that are playable for all characters.   
[/list]

As always, details are subject to change as we get through development. Let’s break these down one at a time and dig into the details. 

[u][b]CONSOLE SUPPORT [/b][/u]
With the launch of Season 02, we will be launching EvilVEvil on Playstation 5 and Xbox Series X | S. 

[u][b]ARENA MODE[/b][/u]
Arena Mode is an all new mode that is built around the idea of giving our players a new challenge where they try to achieve the highest possible combo score as a team during a series of short and intense battles. 

The arenas are taken from our favorite parts of the existing levels, but slightly modified for Arena Mode. Every run will take you through a number of sites and the challenge can be completed in 15-20 minutes… if you survive. The better you do, the more difficult it gets and the better your bragging rights become. 

We are aiming for around a dozen arenas to check out in Season 02 - Up Close and Personal. We hope you love the condensed battle madness as much as we do and we will check in with you to see what you think of this mode for future seasons! 


[u][b]NEW CHARACTERS[/b][/u]
In addition to an all-new game mode, we also wanted to create more ways to enjoy the Season 01 content, with fresh characters, new abilities, and more possibilities for crazy team compositions. 

We will share more information in the future as we get closer to the launch of Season 02, so this is just a teaser of one of our new playable characters…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871285/1a7852b201ab39a939941892881feebd8651f778.png[/img]

[b]Hellena[/b] - Hellena is a traveler and a scholar, who has wandered the earth for centuries. Her journey began in Africa in the early 12th century, when she was attacked and left for dead by feral vampires. She used her knowledge of nature and the elements to survive, and later turned. With her newfound power she exacted revenge on her assailants and began exploring life as a vampire.

Over the years her knowledge of natural magic has deepened and her connection to the dark sides of nature grants her tremendous power. She respects the power of nature more than anything and has an admiration for all animals, even humans. Rather than stand in opposition with the human race, she would have them educated and guided to better understand nature’s power and their place in it.

Hellena’s abilities allow her to step between dimensions and unleash waves of ravens to distract her foes. Hellena is extremely adept at keeping her teammates alive, even under heavy fire. 


[u][b]NEW WEAPONS[/b][/u]
Getting your hands on some new hardware can make all of the difference when it comes to sending demons back to hell. These new pieces will give your arsenal a new feel when you land in those arenas and just might keep you alive a bit longer. 

[list]
[*] [b]Breya Cascade[/b] - A kinetic assault rifle with a tendency for critical hits. 
[*] [b]Breya Stream[/b] - The smallest kinetic machine pistol in the game with an insanely high rate of fire, great for agile builds. 
[*] [b]Caretta 9M[/b] - A kinetic semi auto pistol with a semi-auto rate of fire and high damage output. 
[*] [b]Saber Bolt[/b] - A solar revolver, relatively slow firing, but it makes up for it with damage per hit.
[*] [b]Saber Storm[/b] - A solar light machine gun. Obviously a bit heavier than the other guns, but more than capable to solve any demonic infestation as long as you aim in the general direction of the problematic being.
[/list]

 
In addition to all of the above, we will also have a list of quality of life improvements coming with the Season 02 update based on player feedback. Again, just a note that the above is based on our current plans, but details are always subject to change as we finalize development.

Please let us know your thoughts, what you are loving about EvilvEvil, and what you want to see more of in future updates!  

-The EvilvEvil Team at Toadman!

notes.notes:
Normally in co-op shooters, you play as a rag-tag group of individually helpless survivors - you need your team to survive in games like Left 4 Dead, Vermintide, and Back 4 Blood. In EvilVEvil, you're pretty ferocious in your own right, and that is because you play as a vampire armed, as it were, to the teeth. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, you're in luck: EvilVEvil has a free demo you can play right now.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889451/d83b1ebbeaadc5a7fd7a5617a2b09d09003781f0.jpg[/img]
First of all, thank you yet again for participating in Evil V Evil’s closed beta. We greatly appreciate your support and continue to do our best to fix all the issues reported by our beta testers! 

This is the last planned closed beta before Evil participates in Steam’s upcoming FPS-Fest in April - which will have an open demo for all to play! We’re looking forward to everyone having a chance to try out Evil V Evil very soon.

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

[b]Tech:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed number display and added support for millions. (You did make Persephida proud!)
[*] Destructible Objects can now be damaged with quick-melee.
[*] More fixes to weapon animations.
[*] Optimization for the matchmaking scene.
[*] Fixed a problem where clients did not get outlines on enemies.
[*] Various graphical optimizations.
[*] Additional improvements to the GPU detection.
[/list]
[b]Core Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased audio damage feedback when being damaged from behind. 
[*] Fixed issue where enemies would move between cover without playing animations.
[*] Tweaked Bone Gunners behavior and balancing.
[*] Heavies can no longer be staggered when their shield is up and fixed a bug where shields would go invisible after attempting to bite Heavies with their shield up.
[*] Enemies will now smoothly aim towards the players instead of snapping towards them.
[/list]
[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*] BAR-17 - Adjusted the scope  to be better usable.
[*] JGI-AC 26 Burst - Increased Damage per round, fire rate and shortened pause between bursts.
[/list]
[b]Levels:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The warehouse - Tweaked spawning for a more consistent experience and tweaked shading environment to make heaviest shields more visible in certain places. Fixed potential soft lock.
[*] Deep Downtown - Added more occult pressure at the end of the first level. Fixed potential soft lock.
[*] Infiltrate to annihilate - Added an objective for more streamlined experience and increased occult pressure in the first level.
[/olist]

Thank you again and good hunting! Here are some bonus weapon concepts!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889451/d83b1ebbeaadc5a7fd7a5617a2b09d09003781f0.jpg[/img]
First of all we want to say a huge thank you to everyone that participated in the first Closed Beta. We have been blown away by the kind words and great feedback. Your testing highlights a variety of issues and helps us tremendously to prioritize all the possible improvements that we strive for to make the game better. 

Here is a list of the fixes that we worked on to deliver you a better experience.

[b]Tech:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved GPU detection and possibility to define the used GPU in settings to tackle performance issues some players faced. If you are still experiencing performance issues please let us know
[/list]
[b]Core Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Feeding - first health tick comes in earlier now, also split the health gain in more ticks to speed up the average health gain towards the start of the feeding
[*] Melee - increased range by 10%
[*] Mashakas Gateway - made faster and more fluid, also added a small explosion on exit
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889451/87e54ec870e561980f9d94433568d49c74ed9333.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889451/755107fcff66695b2b9486aaf240fbba6b3191dd.gif[/img]

[b]Artifacts:[/b]
[list]
[*] Teleport - rebalanced explosion damage, now also adds a fire DoT to enemies
[*] Blood reload - changed the reload to happen at the start of the feeding, not when you reach 100% health
[*] Pyro - removed an unwanted legacy health buff that came with the artifact
[*] Choke - bug fix with calculations
[/list]
[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cut the Cult - changed layout and scripting of the final fight in the second level and removed a potential softlock
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Renamed “Extra 1” to “Mouse 4” + “Extra 2” to “Mouse 5” in the controls
[*] Minor Text updates
[*] Improvements to matchmaking
[*] Fixed an array of bugs regarding weapon animations
[*] Moved epilepsy warning to before intro
[/list]

Thank you again and good hunting! Make Persephida proud!

notes.title: New Steam FPS is a cyberpunk Left 4 Dead with vampires
notes.notes:
I wanted to love Redfall. I previewed the game almost a year ago today in Bethesda's dimly lit London studio, and while I didn't walk away with the highest hopes, a part of me dared to dream that we'd finally get a new, good vampire game. Unfortunately, it largely failed to deliver, and early previews of Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 haven't done much to rile up my inner Beast either. So, when EvilVEvil crossed my desk, I was excited to sink my fangs into a different vampire adventure - and I walked away with my hunger somewhat sated.

It's no secret that I absolutely adore vampires. The game I'm looking forward to the most this year is Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2, and I've vehemently defended what Redfall could have been - and still can be. So, when Toadman's new vampire FPS EvilVEvil crossed my desk, it's safe to say I dove in fangs first.
